EN.bani: Websites keep changing and bot checks block them, so scraping code kept breaking. The maker built a framework that can still find an element after a page changes, and helps get past bot checks.
EN.job: Data engineers, Python developers, researchers, people learning AI automation.
EN.kahan: Price tracking, market research, lead lists, AI data collection.
EN.kya: Scrapling is a Python framework for pulling data from websites (web scraping). It has fast HTTP requests, stealth browsers (that look like a real user), parsing, and features to crawl many pages at once.
EN.need: If you need data from many websites, like prices or job listings, copying by hand is a long job. For example, you want the prices of 100 shops in one sheet every day; this becomes automatic.
EN.rn: Medium risk because it has features that get past bot checks and scraping can break a website's rules (question 5). On some sites this can become a legal issue. Scrape only sites whose rules allow it.
win: You need Python. In the terminal: `pip install scrapling`
For the browser features: `pip install "scrapling[fetchers]"` then `scrapling install`
For AI or shell features see the other options in the README (like `pip install "scrapling[shell]"`).

R.bani: Websites badalti rehti hain aur bot-check unhe rok deta hai, isliye scraping code baar baar toot jata tha. Maker ne aisa framework banaya jo page badalne par bhi element dhundh leta hai aur bot-check se bachne mein madad karta hai.
R.job: Data engineers, Python developers, researchers, AI automation learners.
R.kahan: Price tracking, market research, lead lists, AI data collection.
R.kya: Scrapling websites se data nikalne (web scraping) ka Python framework hai. Isme tez HTTP requests, stealth browsers (jo asli user jaise dikhte hain), parsing aur ek saath kai pages crawl karne ke features hain.
R.need: Agar aapko kai websites se data chahiye, jaise prices ya job listings, to haath se copy karna lamba kaam hai. Jaise aap 100 shops ke daam roz ek sheet mein jama karna chahte hain; ye kaam automatic ho jata hai.
R.rn: Medium risk kyunki ye bot-check se bachne ke features deta hai aur scraping se website rules tod sakte hain (sawaal 5). Kuch sites par ye legal issue ban sakta hai. Sirf wahi sites scrape karein jinke rules ise allow karte hain.
win: Python chahiye. Terminal mein: `pip install scrapling`
Browser wale features chahiye to: `pip install "scrapling[fetchers]"` phir `scrapling install`
AI ya shell features ke liye README ke aur options dekhein (jaise `pip install "scrapling[shell]"`).

EN.bani: The maker says traditional knowledge should not be locked away. So they made the charting algorithm and the knowledge base open source. It is an open snapshot of the engine behind ouranic.cn.
EN.job: Web developers, app builders, makers of astrology and culture projects, AI dataset researchers.
EN.kahan: Astrology apps, culture websites, research projects.
EN.kya: This is an engine that makes Zi Wei Dou Shu (a Chinese astrology method) charts. You give a birth date and time and it builds the chart. It also comes with a big interpretation dataset (written readings).
EN.need: If you are building an astrology app or website, writing the chart math yourself is hard. For example, you make a small app where a user enters a birth date and sees a chart; this engine does the math.
EN.rn: Low risk. It does not need control of any account or computer. Keep in mind: it is only a traditional method, not scientific proof, and the dataset is very big (56.6 GB according to the README).
EN.type: Zi Wei Dou Shu (Chinese astrology) chart engine
win: You need Node.js. In the terminal: `git clone https://github.com/Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu.git`
Then: `cd ziwei-doushu` and `npm ci`
To run the demo: `npm run dev` (the chart demo opens at http://localhost:3000/chart)

R.bani: Maker ka kehna hai ki traditional knowledge locked nahi hona chahiye. Isliye unhone charting algorithm aur knowledge base open source kar diye. Ye ouranic.cn ke engine ka open snapshot hai.
R.job: Web developers, app builders, astrology aur culture projects wale makers, AI dataset researchers.
R.kahan: Astrology apps, culture websites, research projects.
R.kya: Ye Zi Wei Dou Shu (Chinese astrology ka ek tarika) ka chart banane wala engine hai. Janam ki date aur time dene par chart banta hai, aur saath mein bada interpretation dataset (padhne ke liye likhe hue jawab) bhi hai.
R.need: Agar aap astrology app ya website bana rahe hain, to chart ka hisaab khud likhna mushkil hai. Jaise aap ek chhota app banate hain jisme user apni janam date daale aur chart dekhe; ye engine wo hisaab de deta hai.
R.rn: Low risk. Koi account ya computer control nahi chahiye. Dhyan rahe: ye sirf ek tradition ka way hai, science ka proof nahi, aur dataset bahut bada hai (README ke hisaab se 56.6 GB).
R.type: Zi Wei Dou Shu (Chinese astrology) chart engine
win: Node.js chahiye. Terminal mein: `git clone https://github.com/Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu.git`
Phir: `cd ziwei-doushu` aur `npm ci`
Demo chalane ke liye: `npm run dev` (chart demo http://localhost:3000/chart par khulta hai)

EN.kahan: Fintech, trading research and personal investing.
EN.kya: Uses AI to analyse your chosen stocks (mainly China, US and HK markets) every day and sends a dashboard.
EN.need: If you are learning about stocks, a daily summary saves time. Example: each morning your phone gets 'watch these 5 stocks today'. This is not financial advice.
EN.rn: Low risk because there is no exploit or script, but trading on such signals can cause money loss, so use it only to learn.
win: Please see the official README

R.bani: Roz news, price aur indicators (chart ke signals) alag alag dekhna thakane wala hai. Yeh project data jodta hai, AI se report banata hai aur WeChat, Telegram, Slack ya email par bhejta hai.
R.job: Data analyst, fintech developer, AI automation learner, retail investor.
R.kahan: Fintech, trading research aur personal investing.

R.rn: Low risk kyunki koi exploit ya script nahi hai, par stock signals par depend karke paisa lagana loss kara sakta hai, isliye sirf seekhne ke liye use karein.

and: It does not run on a phone; it is a tool for a Linux server or computer.
EN.bani: Big companies must run many clusters on GPU machines, and doing it by hand is hard. NVIDIA built a management layer that creates, grows and removes clusters.
EN.job: Platform engineers, DevOps, AI infrastructure teams.
EN.kahan: Data centers, AI companies, cloud teams.
EN.kya: Builds a 'managed Kubernetes' (a system for running groups of apps on many machines) on your own NVIDIA GPU servers. It is a preview version, not ready for real production yet.
EN.need: A platform team has to give each customer a separate cluster. Example: a company's AI team needs a GPU cluster right now, and this tool makes it for them.
EN.rn: Medium risk because it takes control of whole servers and clusters (question 2). The README itself says: in preview, API login is off and plain HTTP is used, so do not run it in production.
EN.type: Kubernetes cluster manager (for NVIDIA GPU servers)
win: `git clone https://github.com/dsx-ai-factory/nvke.git`
`make build`
Test with the local quickstart first (you need Docker and a Linux host).

and: Phone par nahi chalta; ye Linux server ya computer ka tool hai.
R.bani: Badi companies ko GPU machines par kai cluster chalane padte hain, aur ye kaam haath se karna mushkil hai. NVIDIA ne ek management layer banayi jo clusters banati, badhati aur hatati hai.
R.job: Platform engineers, DevOps, AI infrastructure teams.
R.kahan: Data centers, AI companies, cloud teams.
R.kya: NVIDIA ke apne GPU servers par 'managed Kubernetes' (cluster chalane ka system) banata hai. Preview version hai, abhi production ke liye nahi.
R.need: Platform team ko apne customers ko alag-alag cluster dene hote hain. Example: ek company ke AI team ko turant GPU cluster chahiye, to ye tool use banakar de deta hai.
R.rn: Medium risk kyunki ye poore servers aur clusters ka control leta hai (sawaal 2). README khud kehta hai: preview mein API authentication band hoti hai aur plain HTTP chalta hai, isliye production mein na chalayein.
R.type: Kubernetes cluster manager (NVIDIA GPU servers ke liye)
win: `git clone https://github.com/dsx-ai-factory/nvke.git`
`make build`
Pehle local quickstart se test karein (Docker aur Linux host chahiye).

EN.bani: AI agents forget everything when a chat ends. This project stores facts with their sources, lets you correct or remove them, and lets different agents like Claude Code and Codex use the same memory. Made by Garry Tan.
EN.job: AI automation developer, solo founder, product manager, researcher.
EN.kahan: Startups, consulting, and research teams that use AI agents daily.
EN.kya: Gives an AI agent a memory that saves facts with their sources and can be shared across agents.
EN.need: If you use AI often, repeating context is tiring. Example: you say once 'my client is Mr. Sharma, report due Friday', and the next agent remembers too.
EN.rn: Medium risk because the hosted install runs a script from the internet (question 3) and the memory connects to your agent accounts (question 2).
win: `bun install -g github:garrytan/gbrain#stable`
Please see the official README: this project's hosted installer runs a script from the internet, so the command is not shown here (why: if the website changes, a wrong script could run).

and: Official README dekhein: README mein Android tablet ke steps nahi hain.
R.bani: AI agents baat khatam hote hi sab bhool jate hain. Yeh project facts ko sahi source ke saath store karta hai, aap unhe sudhaar (correct) ya hata sakte hain, aur wahi memory Claude Code, Codex jaise alag agents use kar sakte hain. Made by Garry Tan.
R.job: AI automation developer, solo founder, product manager, researcher.
R.kahan: Startups, consulting, research teams jo AI agents roz use karte hain.
R.kya: AI agent ke liye ek yaadasht (memory) banata hai jo facts ko unke source ke saath save karti hai aur kai agents mein share hoti hai.
R.need: Agar aap AI se lagataar kaam karwate hain, to har baar context batana thakane wala hai. Example: aap ek baar likhein 'mera client Sharma ji hai, report Friday ko', agla agent bhi yaad rakhega.
R.rn: Medium risk kyunki hosted install internet se seedhi script chalata hai (sawaal 3) aur memory aapke agents ke accounts se judti hai (sawaal 2).
win: `bun install -g github:garrytan/gbrain#stable`
Official README dekhein: is project ka hosted installer internet se script chalata hai, isliye woh command yahan nahi di gayi (kyun: website badal jaye to galat script chal sakti hai).

and: It does not run on a phone; it is a tool for a computer.
EN.bani: In long coding sessions the AI's memory fills up and the cost grows. This plugin sits in the middle and shortens old talk.
EN.job: AI developers, power users of coding agents.
EN.kya: Makes a long AI chat shorter so fewer tokens (the units an AI counts and charges by) are used. It claims 5 times fewer tokens and month-long single sessions.
EN.need: When an agent works on a big project, the chat gets very long. Example: running a week-long coding session without starting a new chat again and again.
EN.rn: Medium risk because it can see all the traffic between your tool and the AI service, and some modes in the README use a certificate trick (cert-MITM) (question 2). Use it only in a setup you trust.
EN.type: Context compression plugin for AI agents
win: `npm install -g billion-context --prefix=~/.local`
For Windows, please see the official README.

and: Phone par nahi; ye computer ka tool hai.
R.bani: Lambe coding sessions mein AI ki memory bhar jaati hai aur kharcha badhta hai. Is plugin ne beech mein baithkar purani baatein chhoti kar di.
R.job: AI developers, power users of coding agents.
R.kya: Lambi AI chat ko chhota karta hai taaki kam tokens (AI ka kaam ginne ki unit) lagein. Claim hai: 5 guna kam tokens aur mahine bhar ek hi session.
R.need: Agent se bada project karwate time chat bahut lambi ho jaati hai. Example: ek hafte ka coding session bina bar-bar nayi chat shuru kiye chalana.
R.rn: Medium risk kyunki ye aapke tool aur AI service ke beech ka saara traffic dekh sakta hai, aur README ke kuch modes mein certificate (cert-MITM) use hota hai (sawaal 2). Sirf bharosemand setup mein chalayein.
R.type: AI agent ke liye context compression plugin
win: `npm install -g billion-context --prefix=~/.local`
Windows ke liye Official README dekhein.

EN.job: IoT engineer, smart-home developer, healthcare tech researcher, embedded developer.
EN.kahan: Smart homes, elder care, security and research labs.
EN.kya: Uses ordinary WiFi signals to detect people in a room and measure breathing and heart rate, with no camera.
EN.need: If you want to watch a room without a camera, this helps. Example: at night, an alert if an elderly person's breathing stops.
EN.rn: Medium risk because special hardware and models come from outside sites (question 4), and people's privacy needs care.
win: `npx @ruvnet/ruview@0.9.1 doctor`

and: Official README dekhein: ESP32 hardware chahiye, tablet par seedhe chalane ke steps README mein alag hain.

R.job: IoT engineer, smart-home developer, healthcare tech researcher, embedded developer.
R.kahan: Smart homes, elder care, security aur research labs.
R.kya: Normal WiFi signal se kamre mein logon ko detect karta hai, saans aur heart rate naapta hai, bina camera ke.
R.need: Agar aap bina camera ke room mein presence ya bimar vyakti ki saans monitor karna chahte hain, to yeh idea kaam aata hai. Example: raat ko dadi ji ke kamre mein saans ruk jaye to alert aa jaye.
R.rn: Medium risk kyunki special hardware aur models bahar ki site se download hote hain (sawaal 4) aur logon ki privacy ka dhyan rakhna zaroori hai.
